verdict.text: Weights fitted on the train split alone separate the top from the bottom score quintile on the held-out test split by more than the hand-set heuristic does.

method: Each weight is set in proportion to that feature's exceed-rate lift — how much more often the expected-move band breaks at the favourable end of the feature than at the unfavourable end. Lift is measured on a train split, a gap of one horizon is dropped so no training outcome reaches into the test period, and the train-split weights are scored on the held-out rest by comparing the top and bottom fifth of the score. The weights the scanner runs on are refitted on all history.
